Article Title: FIR filed against ex-BJP MP Pratap Simha over 'provocative' speech during Ganesha procession
Article Text:
In the grand procession of Lord Ganesha organized by the Hindu Jagarana Vedike and the Hindu Mahaganapati Pratishthapana Committee in T. Narasipura.

Row over police warning

NEW DELHI: Karnataka Police on Sunday registered an FIR against former BJP MP Pratap Simha and others over an alleged provocative speech made during a Ganesha idol procession in T Narasipura, Mysuru.The FIR was registered at the T Narasipura police station following a complaint by a police sub-inspector, who alleged that Simha made derogatory remarks over a microphone targeting Inspector Dhananjay during Friday’s procession.The procession and idol immersion were held amid tight security.The FIR comes amid a controversy over a reported warning by the T Narasipura town police inspector to organisers installing Ganesha idols in public ahead of the festival. The inspector had reportedly asked them not to burst crackers in front of a mosque during the idol procession, triggering protests by opposition parties.Reacting to the FIR, Simha alleged that he had been booked under pressure from Karnataka home minister Priyank Kharge and said he would approach the court.“I, too, got to know about the FIR through the media. Why has an FIR been registered? If an FIR has been registered for inciting, who was inciting? It was the inspector who did it.An FIR should have been filed against him,” Simha told reporters.He alleged that the inspector had instigated the situation and made derogatory remarks against those following “Hindutvavadis”.“We have respect for the police department, and there are several good officers here in Mysuru. Why have such a person among them? An FIR should have been filed against the inspector, and action should be taken against him,” he said.Simha further claimed that 21 FIRs had previously been registered against him and that the latest case was the 22nd.“We know who the Home minister is. Under pressure from him, the FIR has been filed... Twenty-one FIRs have been filed against me; this is the 22nd. All cases against me are on Hindutva and nationalist issues... I will go to court and seek justice,” he said.
Article Summary: Karnataka Police register an FIR against former BJP MP Pratap Simha over an alleged provocative speech made during a Ganesha idol procession. Simha alleged that he had been booked under pressure from Karnataka home minister Priyank Kharge and said he would approach the court.

Article Title: 'Method of disenfranchising Indians': Kharge slams SIR, calls it a 'Frankenstein monster'
Article Text:
Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge has lambasted the Election Commission's electoral roll revision, labeling it a misguided 'Frankenstein Monster' that adversely affects its constituents

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Monday stepped up his attack on the Election Commission ’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, describing the exercise as a “Frankenstein Monster” after several prominent political and government figures were issued notices in Delhi.“What started as SIR from Bihar has now knocked on Delhi’s door, and perhaps now the powers-that-be are realizing why the Congress Party has been calling the entire process flawed from day one!” Kharge said in a post on X.“SIR is not just a tool used by the BJP for vote theft and dismantling democracy, it’s a flawed process that has turned into a Frankenstein Monster, now trapping its own people!!”Kharge referred to notices issued to BJP veteran Lal Krishna Advani, external affairs minister S Jaishankar, former vice-president Jagdeep Dhankhar, Delhi Lieutenant Governor, Rajya Sabha members, former Union ministers and other prominent figures. He also referred to an earlier controversy involving Bharat Ratna-winning scientist C N R Rao and former Navy chief Admiral Arun Prakash.The Congress president also questioned the Election Commission’s reference to “VIP/marked electors”, linking it to the constitutional principle of equal voting rights.“Is there now some Special Category of voters in India’s Universal Adult Franchise, VIP voters and ordinary voters?” Kharge asked. “Isn’t this a violation of the constitutional principle of One Person, One Vote, One Value? Has the VIP vote become more valuable now?”Kharge also cited the situation in West Bengal, where Election Commission data submitted before the Supreme Court showed that 1,26,194 appeals against exclusion had been decided.Of these, 1,13,943 voters were ordered to be restored to the electoral rolls, while 8,649 appeals were rejected. Kharge highlighted the fact that around 93 percent of the decided appeals had resulted in restoration.The figure, however, relates only to appeals decided so far and does not mean that 93 percent of all excluded voters were found to have been wrongly removed. More than 37 lakh appeals remained pending, according to the Election Commission data.SIR is an intensive revision of electoral rolls in which election officials verify existing electors and identify entries requiring correction, deletion or further verification. The exercise was first conducted in Bihar before being expanded to other states and Union territories. The process has faced political opposition and legal scrutiny over the verification criteria, documents required and safeguards available to voters.In Delhi, the draft electoral roll published on August 31 contained around 97.5 lakh electors. Around 33.13 lakh voters were identified for notices after their records could not be mapped to the previous intensive revision or were flagged for what officials described as logical discrepancies. More than 31.63 lakh notices had been served as of Sunday.Among those flagged were Advani, Jaishankar, Dhankhar, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal, former deputy chief minister Manish Sisodia and several senior officials. Some cases have already been cleared after documents were verified.The Delhi CEO has maintained that receiving an SIR notice does not mean deletion from the electoral roll. The notices form part of the verification process, and voters are allowed to submit documents and make representations before any decision is taken. The final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on November 4.
Article Summary: Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge has lambasted the Election Commission's electoral roll revision. He described the exercise as a misguided 'Frankenstein Monster' that adversely affects its constituents. Kharge referred to notices issued to BJP veteran Lal Krishna Advani, external affairs minister S Jaishankar, former vice-president Jagdeep Dhankhar.

Article Title: Kejriwal, Sisodia, Sanjay Singh get 4 weeks to reply in Delhi HC contempt case
Article Text:
The Delhi High Court will hear a criminal contempt case against AAP leaders on November 16

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: The Delhi High Court on Monday listed for hearing on November 16 a criminal contempt case against AAP leaders Arvind Kejriwal, Manish Sisodia, Sanjay Singh and others over allegedly “vilifying” social media posts targeting Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma.A bench of Justices Navin Chawla and Arun Bhardwaj granted Kejriwal and the other accused four weeks to file their replies.Kejriwal’s senior counsel told the court that he was yet to receive the complete material on the basis of which the contempt proceedings were initiated. The bench directed the registry to provide the material, which was stated to be incomplete.“Reply, if any, to be filed in four weeks,” the bench said.The court also listed for November 16 a separate contempt petition filed by lawyer Ashok Chaitanya against Kejriwal and others, including AAP leader Gopal Rai and journalist Saurav Das. The petition alleges that they were part of an “orchestrated social media campaign” against Justice Sharma.Justice Sharma had initiated criminal contempt proceedings on May 14 against Kejriwal, Sisodia, Singh and other AAP leaders, including Durgesh Pathak, Saurabh Bharadwaj and Vinay Mishra, over allegedly “vilifying” social media posts concerning her handling of the Delhi excise policy case.Contempt proceedings were also initiated against X user Devesh Vishwakarma.It was further noted the circulation of clips from court proceedings and said the proposed contemnors were attempting to create a “parallel narrative”. She observed that “remaining silent” in such circumstances would not amount to judicial restraint but a “surrender before a powerful litigant”.The contempt proceedings stem from the excise policy case. On February 27, a trial court discharged Kejriwal, Sisodia and 21 others, holding that the prosecution’s case could not withstand judicial scrutiny.
Article Summary: The Delhi High Court will hear a criminal contempt case against AAP leaders on November 16. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma had initiated criminal contempt proceedings on May 14 against Kejriwal, Sisodia, Singh and other AAP leaders. The court also listed for November 16 a separate contempt petition filed by lawyer Ashok Chaitanya.

Sangrur youth consumes poison outside DC office, alleges harassment over drug video.

NEW DELHI: Congress leader Sachin Pilot tore into CM Bhagwant Mann-led Punjab government after a person "consumed poisonous substance" over harassement he allegedly faced for speaking against durg menace in the poll-bound state.Highlighting the incident, which would possibly compound the crisis for the Mann government, Pilot impressed upon the lack of accountablity for such incidents."The kind of pressure and mistreatment being meted out to those raising their voices against drugs in Punjab—this incident in Sangrur is clearly demonstrating it," Sachin Pilot wrote on X.Pilot, who is also Congress party's poll incharge in Punjab, further wrote: "Resident of Namol village, Jagga Singh, consumed a poisonous substance outside the DC's office. Ever since he started posting videos against drugs, he had been receiving threats and being harassed. Amidst grand claims about a drug-free Punjab, such incidents have raised serious questions on the accountability of the AAP government and the administration. ""The ground reality is telling a completely different story—if even those raising their voices against drugs are not safe, then what kind of change are we talking about?" Pilot questioned.On the incident, Dr Iqbal Singh, Civil Hospital Sangrur, said: "We received information about a patient who had been admitted due to phenyl poisoning. Upon bringing the patient into the hospital, we checked their vital signs; the patient was irritable and in a semi-unconscious state. We administered first aid and collected a sample related to the poisoning. We also consulted with the physician, as the patient's blood pressure was slightly elevated. After providing initial treatment, the patient was referred elsewhere. We have informed the police and also brought the matter to the attention of our SMO and senior officers."A political row exploded over the suicide of a 46-year-old Sangrur farmer, an addict’s father, who expressed his pain before finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema at a public rally and asked why Punjab government was unable to rein in the drugs menace.Later, Victim Gulzar Singh’s family members allege that some villagers and police intimidated him for questioning the minister, which drove him to suicide.The incident has put the Mann government under growing pressure over its handling of Punjab's drug menace.Police registered an FIR against five persons, including the sarpanch, her husband and two panchayat members of Toor Banjara village in Cheema’s Dirba assembly constituency. They face charges of abetment to suicide and caste-based humiliation. The sarpanch’s husband denied the allegations.Opposition parties in Punjab, however, are gunning for Cheema and the AAP-led government. Congress functionary Sukhpal Singh Khaira shared a video purportedly showing Gulzar naming Cheema and others, and demanded an FIR against the minister and his associates. Shiromani Akali Dal president Sukhbir Singh Badal visited Gulzar’s family on Tuesday, and demanded an abetment-to-suicide case against Cheema. BJP made the same demand, plus a CBI probe.
Article Summary: Congress leader Sachin Pilot tore into Punjab government after a person "consumed poisonous substance" over harassement he allegedly faced for speaking against durg menace. Pilot: "The kind of pressure and mistreatment being meted out to those raising their voices against drugs in Punjab is clearly demonstrating it"

Article Title: BJP: Rahul should consider becoming stand-up comedian
Article Text:
Union minister Piyush Goyal addressed Rahul as a grumpy ‘fufa’

NEW DELHI: BJP responded to Rahul Gandhi 's attempt to mock PM Narendra Modi with a sharp retort Sunday, saying he should consider becoming a stand-up comedian as he is making Congress unelectable.A stand-up comedian joined Rahul at his 'chhatron ki goonj' programme in Indore and mocked Modi with his comments and mannerism, drawing condemnation from BJP, more so as one of their acts was aimed at PM's gesture of calling for a chair for an elderly woman in a public meeting.Addressing Rahul as a grumpy 'fufa', union minister Piyush Goyal said, "The irony writes itself. The need to come on stage every now and then just to drag PM Modi ji's name into cheap political theatre never fails to amaze me. Look in the mirror, Rahul Gandhi." Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis said, "He has anyway made his party unemployed. At least, he will continue to get employment as a stand-up comedian."
Article Summary: A stand-up comedian joined Rahul at his 'chhatron ki goonj' programme in Indore. Union minister Piyush Goyal addressed Rahul as a grumpy ‘fufa’ Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis said, "He has anyway made his party unemployed"

Karnataka BJP MLAs recite full Vande Mataram after govt limits it to 2 stanzas

NEW DELHI: The recitation of Vande Mataram in the Karnataka Assembly ended after two stanzas, following which BJP MLAs recited the full version of the song, objecting to the decision to limit its rendition.BJP MLA SR Vishwanath criticised the Congress-led Karnataka government over the issue and alleged that the move was aimed at appeasing the party’s central leadership."Even before independence, Congress opposed Vande Mataram and stopped singing it in their meetings. To please Sonia Gandhi, the Congress government in Karnataka, led by Chief Minister DK Shivakumar, brought it to the cabinet and said we will sing only two paragraphs, not the full song. To please the Congress high command, they have truncated Vande Mataram, which is equal to the national anthem. We strongly oppose this. Today, in Vidhana Soudha, if they truncate it, all BJP MLAs will sing the full Vande Mataram song, even if they try to stop us."The BJP MLAs subsequently recited the complete version of Vande Mataram in the Assembly.The Karnataka government had earlier directed that only the first two stanzas of the national song ‘Vande Mataram’ be played or sung at state government programmes and official ceremonies.According to a government order dated September 8, 2026, the decision was taken in accordance with guidelines issued by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs.The order states that, except at programmes attended by the President, Vice President, Prime Minister or Governor, only the first two stanzas of ‘Vande Mataram’ shall be sung at state government programmes.The order was issued in the name of the Governor of Karnataka.
Article Summary: The Karnataka government had earlier directed that only the first two stanzas of the national song ‘Vande Mataram’ be played or sung at state government programmes and official ceremonies. To please Sonia Gandhi, the Congress government in Karnataka, led by Chief Minister DK Shivakumar, brought it to the cabinet and said we will sing only two paragraphs.

Article Title: Not just Rekha Gupta and Arvind Kejriwal: LK Advani, Manish Sisodia issued notices in Delhi SIR
Article Text:
SIR notices issued to LK Advani, Manish Sisodia

From politicians to bureaucrats, thousands face verification over 'discrepancies' in SIR enumeration forms

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: BJP stalwart LK Advani and former Delhi deputy chief minister Manish Sisodia are among the prominent voters whose names figure in the list of 33 lakh people being issued notices over “logical discrepancies” in details furnished during the recent Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise in Delhi.“The notices arose from ‘logical discrepancies’ in the details furnished in their enumeration forms. Their names will be included in the final electoral rolls after due process of verification of facts and documents to be furnished by such voters,” a senior poll officer told PTI, confirming that notices had been issued to both Advani and Sisodia.“The process of verification of facts and documents is underway and validation of entries is being done accordingly,” the officer added.The 98-year-old Advani, a former deputy prime minister, his daughter Pratibha and daughter-in-law Geetika also received notices after their names could not be mapped to the 2002 SIR electoral roll. His son, Jayant, however, cleared the mapping exercise.All four are registered voters in the New Delhi assembly constituency.Meanwhile, in Sisodia’s family, his wife Seema and son Meer have also been issued notices.While the Election Commission has not cited a specific reason for the notice issued to the AAP leader, his son Meer’s notice mentions a “discrepancy in his parent’s name”, according to officials. The notice issued to his wife, Seema, cites a “mismatch in her own name”.Many prominent voters, including senior government functionaries, bureaucrats and politicians, have been issued notices as part of the SIR exercise in Delhi.Chief minister Rekha Gupta, AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal and former Union minister Kapil Sibal have also received notices over similar discrepancies, officials said.Gupta’s entry was validated following verification of her documents, and her name has been cleared for inclusion in the final electoral roll of the Shalimar Bagh constituency, scheduled to be published on November 4.According to the Delhi CEO’s office, notices are being issued to voters whose names could not be linked to the electoral roll prepared during the previous SIR, or whose details showed discrepancies when matched against the earlier roll.As part of the door-to-door verification exercise conducted between June 30 and August 17, every voter was required to submit an enumeration form.Of the around 97 lakh voters included in the draft electoral rolls, 33.13 lakh have been identified for notices over discrepancies in their enumeration forms. More than 31.63 lakh notices have been served so far.Most of the notices relate to the absence of corresponding records in the electoral roll prepared during the previous SIR in 2002.Voters have been asked to submit their replies along with supporting documents to the Electoral Registration Officers of their respective Assembly constituencies by October 29.
Article Summary: LK Advani and Manish Sisodia are among the prominent voters whose names figure in the list of 33 lakh people being issued notices. The notices arose from ‘logical discrepancies’ in the details furnished in their enumeration forms. Their names will be included in the final electoral rolls after due process of verification.

Article Title: 'There should be room for humour in politics': Mamata's TMC on PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi event
Article Text:
PM Modi mimicry at Rahul Gandhi event

NEW DELHI: The Mamata All India Trinamool Congress on Sunday defended Rahul Gandhi over his mimicry of Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the Congress leader's recent 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' programme in Indore, saying that "humour should have a place in politics."The party's senior Lok Sabha MP Saugata Roy said Rahul Gandhi only repeated what PM Modi himself said."No insult has been made. What Prime Minister Modi said has merely been repeated; this is not an insult to anyone. There should be room for humour in politics..." Roy told news agency ANI.His remarks come amid signs of fresh bonhomie between the Congress and the Mamata All India Trinamool Congress. On Friday, former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee, who heads this faction of the TMC, announced that her party would support the Congress candidate in the upcoming Nandigram byelection. The Nandigram seat was vacated by chief minister Suvendu Adhikari, who retained Mamata Banerjee's Bhowanipore stronghold, where he defeated her in the West Bengal assembly elections in April.However, shortly after Mamata Banerjee's announcement, Congress' Nandigram candidate, Milan Pradhan, was arrested in connection with a 2007 case. Pradhan has been sent to judicial custody till October 3.On Saturday, Rahul Gandhi participated in the Indore leg of his "Chhatron Ki Goonj" student interaction programme, sharing the stage with stand-up comedian Pulkit Mani. During the event, the Lok Sabha LoP's remarks and mimicked gestures drew criticism from BJP leaders, who alleged that PM Modi and his late mother were mocked.
Article Summary: The party's senior Lok Sabha MP Saugata Roy said Rahul Gandhi only repeated what PM Modi himself said. His remarks come amid signs of fresh bonhomie between the Congress and the Mamata All India Trinamool Congress. On Friday, former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee announced that her party would support the Congress candidate in the upcoming Nandigram byelection.

Article Title: Maharashtra TET paper leak: 2 key accused arrested; 168 buyers on radar
Article Text:
Two key accused in TET paper leak case arrested

How the leak occured





BHIWANDI: Two key accused allegedly linked to 168 prospective buyers of the leaked Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) question paper have been arrested, nearly two months after police busted the racket, with the SIT now probing the wider network and possible transactions.The two — Pune-based govt employee Prakash Misal and Bihar native Ashok Shaw, who was staying in Delhi — were among the remaining prominent accused identified during the probe. Police said Misal was in touch with around 50 people who had shown interest in buying the paper, while Shaw allegedly maintained a list of 118 prospective buyers. The list was recovered from his Delhi residence.Shaw was arrested in Patna, Bihar, while Misal was arrested near Bhiwandi Naka on Sunday after police learnt he was planning to surrender before a court. Both were produced before the Bhiwandi court and remanded in police custody till Sept 23.The SIT has so far verified 18 of the 118 names on Shaw's list and found they were preparing to appear for the TET examination. Verification of the remaining 100 is underway.Police suspect Shaw was directly linked to Solapur-based coaching-class operator Prakash Pawar, who has already been arrested, and was also in contact with alleged mastermind Bijendra Gupta.Investigators are questioning Misal to determine the price at which he allegedly planned to sell the paper and whether any sale took place. Earlier, accused Kapil Dahiya, who had allegedly travelled to Pune to deliver the paper to Misal, told investigators he could not hand it over.Police had busted the racket two days before the scheduled examination, forcing postponement of the TET.DCP Pawan Bansod confirmed the arrests. ACP Sachin Sangle, part of the SIT, told TOI, "Their interrogation will help us establish to whom they intended to sell the paper."Last week, the SIT filed a 3,470-page chargesheet before the Bhiwandi fast-track court against those arrested earlier in the case.With Misal and Shaw's arrests, police said the two remaining prominent accused identified during the investigation have been apprehended. Further arrests will depend on findings from their contacts and financial transactions.
Article Summary: Pune-based govt employee Prakash Misal and Bihar native Ashok Shaw were among the remaining prominent accused identified during the probe. Police said Misal was in touch with around 50 people who had shown interest in buying the paper. Shaw allegedly maintained a list of 118 prospective buyers.

Article Title: ‘Repeated threats’: Comedian Pulkit Mani cancels Noida, Lucknow, Kanpur shows amid Rahul Gandhi event mimicry row
Article Text:
Comedian Pulkit Mani cancelled shows in three cities after a political controversy arose





NEW DELHI: Stand-up comedian Pulkit Mani on Sunday announced the cancellation of his shows in Noida, Lucknow and Kanpur amid a political controversy over his mimicry of PM Narendra Modi at Congress leader Rahul Gandhi ’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ event in Indore.Mani first announced the cancellation of his Noida show in an Instagram story, citing “unforeseen circumstances” and apologising to his audience for the inconvenience.In next story, he said his shows in Lucknow and Kanpur had also been cancelled, alleging that he had received repeated threats from “goon activists”.The cancellations came a day after Mani performed at the ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ programme organised by Gandhi in Indore. During the event, the comedian mimicked Modi, triggering criticism from BJP leaders, who alleged that the performance contained references to and was disrespectful towards Modi’s late mother.Union minister Arjun Ram Meghwal criticised the performance and questioned the intent behind the remarks. BJP leaders including Satish Poonia, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh, Devendra Fadnavis, Sanjay Saraogi, Ramchander Rao and Shazia Ilmi also attacked Gandhi over the controversy and demanded an apology.Congress leaders, however, rejected the allegations. Madhya Pradesh Congress chief Jitu Patwari said Modi’s late mother was not mocked, while Congress leaders Bhupesh Baghel, Sajjan Singh Verma and Raashid Alvi defended the performance as humour and mimicry. Alvi said Gandhi was merely laughing along with the audience.The ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ programme was centred on issues concerning students and young people, with Congress leaders saying education, employment and other youth-related concerns were the focus of Gandhi’s address.
Article Summary: Comedian Pulkit Mani cancels shows in Noida, Lucknow and Kanpur. Came amid a political controversy over his mimicry of PM Narendra Modi. Mani performed at Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ event in Indore.

Article Title: 5th case slapped on Congress’ Nandigram nominee Milan Pradhan, party to move Calcutta HC
Article Text:
Congress candidate for the Nandigram Assembly by-election Milan Pradhan, who has been arrested in connection with an old murder case





Nandigram: Congress ’s Nandigram bypoll candidate Milan Pradhan was slapped with another case on Sunday – taking the case count against him to five. Following this, Congress said it would move Calcutta High Court seeking Pradhan’s bail.Pradhan is already in judicial custody until Oct 3 in three 2007 cases registered during the land acquisition movement that implicate him for murder, among other charges, registered at Nandigram police station. On Saturday, Khejuri police submitted an arrest warrant in a fourth case, and Nandigram cops filed another on Sunday. Pradhan is scheduled to be produced before both Contai and Haldia sub-divisional courts on Monday.Speaking on this, West Bengal Pradesh Congress Committee spokesperson Ajitesh Pandey said, “Milan Pradhan is being deliberately entangled in one legal hassle after another. He was arrested right before the Nandigram bypoll in a 19-year-old case, and police are continually filing new warrants. We will approach the Calcutta High Court for his bail either on Monday or Tuesday.”Pandey alleged, “Given the fresh cases filed, his stepping out of jail before the election seems doubtful.”He went on to say, “Nearly 40 individuals were named in almost every case. Police claim they couldn’t trace 20 of them. Of the remaining 20, how is it that the police only managed to find Milan Pradhan?”Pandey added, “The original complainants themselves had expressed a desire to withdraw these cases. In 2025, Trinamool reopened these files to target Suvendu Adhikari (then the leader of opposition) and his aides. Today, that very weapon is being used against Milan.”Speaking on the party’s possible legal strategy in HC, a Congress senior said, “We will ask why it was necessary to arrest Pradhan 19 years after the incident, particularly after he physically submitted his nomination at the Haldia SDO’s office and was actively campaigning in Nandigram.”“Pradhan could have reported to the police station whenever summoned for investigation, yet police chose to arrest him,” the neta added.Speaking on how this has hit Congress’s campaign, Pandey said, “Congress is yet to launch its campaign in Nandigram, with workers preoccupied with the legal trouble. However, Milan’s election agent and workers will soon hit the ground for booth-level campaigning. Congress will pour its full strength into the electoral fight as well.”
Article Summary: Nandigram bypoll candidate Milan Pradhan was slapped with another case on Sunday – taking the case count against him to five. Following this, Congress said it would move Calcutta High Court seekingPradhan’s bail. He is already in judicial custody until Oct 3 in three 2007 cases registered during the land acquisition movement.

Article Title: 23-year-old dies after collapsing on PEMT track at Delhi Police training centre
Article Text:
The deceased was identified as Saurabh Kumar(Representative image)





NEW DELHI: A 23-year-old man died after collapsing during a race while appearing for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PEMT) at the Delhi Police Academy (DPA) in Wazirabad on Monday, police said.The deceased was identified as Saurabh Kumar , son of Lachhi Singh and a resident of Neta Nagar in Salamatpur village of Uttar Pradesh's Anupshahr.According to police, information was received at Sonia Vihar police station at around 11.11 am from Jag Pravesh Chandra (JPC) Hospital regarding a person who had been brought to the emergency department by a PCR van from DPA, Wazirabad, and was declared brought dead by doctors.Police said Kumar was appearing for the ongoing PEMT at the academy when he suddenly collapsed on the track during the race. He was immediately provided initial medical assistance and was shifted to JPC Hospital by PCR staff.However, doctors at the hospital declared him brought dead, police said.The body has been sent to GTB Hospital for post-mortem examination to ascertain the exact cause of death.Police said proceedings under Section 194 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) have been initiated at Sonia Vihar police station.
Article Summary: 23-year-old man died after collapsing during a race while appearing for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PEMT) at the Delhi Police Academy. The deceased was identified as Saurabh Kumar, son of Lachhi Singh and a resident of Salamatpur village of Uttar Pradesh.

Article Title: Speeding SUV hits bike in Vashi, 3 youths injured; driver traced
Article Text:
Accused driver of SUV Mahindra Thar escaping after accident





NAVI MUMBAI: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday.The incident took place around 1am. The injured youths were initially taken to NMMC Hospital in Vashi and were later referred to Sion Hospital for further treatment.Following the incident, a biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police then traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number.During the investigation, it was learnt that the owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride. Police subsequently traced his mobile tower location to an area near the creek in Sector 12, Vashi, where he was allegedly hiding.He was detained and served a notice under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), following which he was released.
Article Summary: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday. A biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number. The owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride.

Article Title: Quack doctor detained in Maharashtra for practising medicine without registration
Article Text:
A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel police after an inspection (Representative image)





NAVI MUMBAI: A 27-year-old quack doctor was detained by Panvel taluka police after a complaint was lodged by the medical officer of the Primary Health Centre at Ajivali village in Panvel taluka, following an inspection by health department officials at his illegal clinic in Kasalkhand village on Monday afternoon.The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal and resides in an MHADA building in India Bulls Township, Kon village, Panvel.Gajanan Ghadge, senior inspector of Panvel taluka police, informed that the complaint was lodged by medical officer Dr Sayali Mankar, 33, who inspected Haq's clinic in Kasalkhand village and found that he was an unqualified and unregistered medical practitioner allegedly practising modern medicine by posing as a doctor.He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.Inspector Ghadge said, "We have invoked relevant sections of the Maharashtra Medical Practitioners Act, 1961, against the accused, which prohibit any person from practising medicine in the state unless their name is registered under the relevant statutory provisions and prescribe criminal penalties and fines for those who illegally practise medicine without valid registration. Under the law, the accused was served a notice under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), directing him to appear for inquiry when summoned and during the court proceedings. "
Article Summary: The accused was identified as Noorul Huda Imamul Haq, who hails from West Bengal. He had been running the clinic and treating patients for the past one month, police said. The police seized medicines stocked at the clinic as evidence.

Article Title: 'Grabbed hand and attempted to disrobe': Cab driver tries to assault woman passenger near Navi Mumbai airport
Article Text:
Police have registered a case and are searching for the accused driver (Representative image)





NAVI MUMBAI: A woman passenger travelling home after attending a party in Chembur allegedly faced molestation and an attempted assault by a cab driver who took the vehicle to a deserted road near Navi Mumbai airport late on Saturday night, police said on Sunday.The incident took place around 1.30am on the airport service road, about two kilometres from Navi Mumbai airport, police said. The accused allegedly stopped the cab on the pretext of drinking water before moving to the rear seat beside the woman, police said.According to the police, the woman was travelling to Panvel after a friend booked a cab for her following the party."The driver stopped the vehicle on the deserted service road, stepped out briefly, and then re-entered the car, sitting on the rear seat next to the woman. He allegedly grabbed her hand and attempted to disrobe her," said an official of the Navi Mumbai Police.The woman managed to break free and escape from the vehicle, following which the driver allegedly fled the spot.After the incident, the woman contacted her family and went to Panvel Police Station to lodge a complaint.Since the alleged incident took place within the jurisdiction of Navi Mumbai airport police station, Panvel police escorted her to the appropriate police station.Based on her complaint, Navi Mumbai Airport Police registered a case against the accused, identified as Mohammad Afzal Shaikh, under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).Police have launched a search for Shaikh and are using technical intelligence to trace his whereabouts.Further investigation is underway.(With ANI inputs)(The victim's identity has not been revealed to protect her privacy as per Supreme court directives on cases related to sexual assault)
Article Summary: A woman passenger travelling home after attending a party in Chembur allegedly faced molestation and an attempted assault by a cab driver. The incident took place around 1.30am on the airport service road, about two kilometres from Navi Mumbai airport. The woman managed to break free and escape from the vehicle, following which the driver allegedly fled the spot.

Article Title: Cong neta seeks protection for 'gangrape' survivor, her kin
Article Text:
(Representative image)





THANE: A day after Padgha police registered an FIR against former Kalyan West MLA Narendra Pawar and dismissed policeman Shailesh Patil for allegedly gangraping a 22-year-old married woman at a farmhouse in Bapgaon, Congress group leader in KDMC Kanchan Kulkarni on Friday sought police protection for the survivor and her family.Kulkarni, who accompanied the woman to the police station, claimed the survivor's life was in danger because of the accused's influence. She urged CM Eknath Shinde to intervene and ensure security for her.Meanwhile, Padgha police conducted a spot panchnama at the farmhouse in Bapgaon to collect forensic evidence. Seperate police teams have also been formed to trace Pawar and Patil, who remain absconding. Pawar has denied the charge, calling them false. He has also resigned from all his BJP organisational posts. - Pradeep Gupta
Article Summary: Congress group leader in KDMC Kanchan Kulkarni sought police protection for the survivor and her family. She urged CM Eknath Shinde to intervene and ensure security for her. Padgha police conducted a spot panchnama at the farmhouse in Bapgaon to collect forensic evidence.

Article Title: Dharapuram bypoll: Nine AIADMK functionaries booked for attack on TVK candidate’s car
Article Text: TIRUPUR: Police have registered a case against AIADMK candidate K Bhanumathi and eight party functionaries following a complaint alleging that the car of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) candidate P Sathyabama was intercepted and damaged after she filed her nomination papers for the Oct 6 Dharapuram byelection.Besides Bhanumathi, Dharapuram police booked former ministers Pollachi V Jayaraman and Dindigul C Sreenivasan, and party functionaries Senthilkumar, Rajendran, Deepa, Gomathi, Rani and Muthumani. Police have invoked 10 sections, including provisions relating to insulting a woman, damaging private property and acts allegedly intended to provoke violence or rioting.The complaint was lodged by Gayathri, treasurer of the TVK’s 18th ward in Dharapuram, on Thursday. She alleged that AIADMK functionaries, who had come to file nominations, stopped Sathyabama’s car while she was returning from the nomination centre.According to the complaint, the AIADMK functionaries damaged the vehicle and used abusive and derogatory language against the TVK candidate. It alleged that their actions were aimed at provoking clashes between AIADMK and TVK supporters.
Article Summary: Police have registered a case against AIADMK candidate K Bhanumathi and eight party functionaries. A complaint alleges that the car of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) candidate P Sathyabama was intercepted and damaged after she filed her nomination papers for the Oct 6 Dharapuram byelection.

Article Title: Auto driver arrested for threatening, assaulting cops in Yercaud
Article Text:
Representative image





SALEM: The Yercaud police have arrested an autorickshaw driver on charges of assaulting a special sub-inspector (SSI) and threatening to kill the SSI and a woman police constable.The arrested auto driver has been identified as Yuvraj, 22, of Mundagampadi. Yuvraj, who was drunk, obstructed vehicles near a Vinayagar statue on Monday. Head constable D Thavamani, who was regulating traffic, intervened. Yuvraj abused her verbally.SSI Aaron Athirubaraj attempted to defuse the situation. “But Yuvraj tore my shirt, struck me on the chest and threatened to kill me and Thavamani,” the SSI said.Police registered a case against Yuvraj under sections relating to obstructing govt servants, assault and criminal intimidation. He was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: The arrested auto driver has been identified as Yuvraj, 22, of Mundagampadi. He was remanded in judicial custody. Police registered a case against him under sections relating to obstructing govt servants, assault and criminal intimidation.

Article Title: Woman alleges obscene gesture by scooter rider in Aluva
Article Text:
Kochi

A 34-year-old woman approached Aluva East Police alleging that an unidentified scooter rider made an obscene gesture at her while she was travelling in a car in Aluva on Thursday.According to the FIR, the incident happened near the Paravur Kavala signal between 5.45pm and 5.55pm. The woman was travelling towards her residence when the scooter rider allegedly approached her car and made an obscene gesture.The complainant, a resident of Idukki, alleged that the gesture was intended to insult and humiliate her.The police are examining CCTV footage from the area to identify and trace the accused.
Article Summary: A 34-year-old woman approached Aluva East Police alleging that an unidentified scooter rider made an obscene gesture at her. The incident happened near the Paravur Kavala signal between 5.45pm and 5.55pm. The police are examining CCTV footage from the area to identify and trace the accused.

Article Title: Kerelam CM stops his convoy to help accident victim reach hospital in pilot vehicle
Article Text:
Chief Minister V D Satheesan helped an injured youth after spotting him on Container Road





KOCHI: A youth injured in a bike accident was taken to hospital in the pilot vehicle of chief minister V D Satheesan after he spotted him lying on Container Road on Sunday evening. The injured person is Alan Livera, 32, of Mulavukad in Ernakulam.The chief minister was travelling from North Paravoor to attend a programme in the city. On noticing the injured youth, Satheesan instructed that he be immediately taken to hospital in the pilot vehicle.According to an officer from Maradu police station, who was part of the pilot team, the youth applied sudden brakes to avoid colliding with another two-wheeler, causing him to fall onto the road. He was subsequently taken to Aster Medcity Hospital by the police.According to hospital authorities, the patient is currently not in critical condition and is under observation.
Article Summary: Chief Minister V D Satheesan helped an injured youth after spotting him on Container Road. Alan Livera, 32, of Mulavukad in Ernakulam, was taken to Aster Medcity Hospital by the police. The patient is currently not in critical condition and is under observation.
